[{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Hey, are you available to chat?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Hi Jane! I'm here. What's going on?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I don't know, it's just been a lot lately. I got a promotion offer, but there's a catch."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Congratulations on the promotion offer! But what’s the catch?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Thanks. It means relocating overseas. I’m feeling pretty overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a big decision. It sounds like there's a lot to consider. How are you feeling about moving overseas?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Honestly, I have mixed feelings. It's a great opportunity, but I’m scared of leaving everything behind. What if I fail?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It’s completely natural to feel that way. You've been through a lot of stressful situations before, remember when you had the falling out with your friend over the money issue, and you managed to handle it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"True, I did handle that. But this feels different, like if I accept, everything changes."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Change can be daunting, but it also can be exciting. Deep down, what does your gut tell you?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"A part of me wants to embrace this challenge. But I worry about my family, especially Eliza after we just started getting along again."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It's understandable to worry about your relationship with Eliza. Have you talked to her about this yet?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Not yet. I'm afraid she’ll feel like I'm abandoning her right when things are starting to get better between us."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Maybe having an open conversation with Eliza would help. She might surprise you with her support, especially after you both mended fences."}]

[{"address":"org-ms-0332fb941d95862cc0df977b89527f88753a2fa6f92ed3a33806842ee371de4a","content":"{\"full_source_conversation\":\"supporter: Hey! How are you?\\nseeker: Hi, I am having a really hard time. I just found out that my boyfriend cheated on me a year ago.\\nsupporter: Have you confronted him about it yet?\\nseeker: Yes, I told him that my best friend confessed it to me. It was my best friend and him. I was so shocked.\\nsupporter: Have you broken up yet?\\nseeker: No, I am so mad but I don't want to break up with him. I told my best friends that I never want to see her again though. My boyfriend and I have plans to get engaged this month. I am furious at him though.\\nsupporter: I think you should postpone the engagement as infidelity during marriage is far more painful\\nsupporter: You are strong if you are able to forgive him though because I know I wouldn't \\nseeker: I have never been so blind sided. Maybe I should reconsider! I have had a guy after me for at least the last year but I never cheated! I really wanted to though.\\nsupporter: No you should never cheat, because you would be on the same wavelength as your boyfriend. Instead, if you like the other man then you should go where your feelings take you :)\\nseeker: I am thinking that you are right. I feel like my whole world is upside down and I have wasted all this time with the wrong guy and the wrong best friend. I also wonder who else he might have cheated on my with. \\nsupporter: Yeah, that might be true, a relationship isn't healthy if you are cheated on\\nseeker: I am so grossed out because I am a germaphobe to begin with. I have not slept with any other person in my whole life so I feel like I am ruined. I want to throw up when I think of him cheating on me. I want to get married and I have a timeline so I am also really confused on what to do if I dump him.\\nsupporter: To dump him is the best thing to do in my opinion. But always go where your heart is, because you won't be happy if you don't. If you do though, there are plenty men out there, and one of them is chasing you\\nseeker: Yeah, the guy who liked me was super rich too! My boyfriend is telling me that he wants my best friend to still be in the wedding party too. She was suppose to be my maid of honor, no less.\\nsupporter: Yeah, but don't go with him because of he money though, genuinely get to know him first\\nseeker: I have compartmentalized my life and never thought of looking around at my other options. You are making really good points. I need to just stop and really look at my options. I never realized that I have options, it's not like i am even engaged yet.\\nsupporter: Yeah, you have a lot of options at this stage, so always do what your heart is telling you at the end of the day\\nseeker: It feels good sharing how I feel with you because you don't have a dog in the fight so to speak.\\nsupporter: yeah, lool something like that ;). Glad your better\\nseeker: I never listen to my heart and think that is a great place to start. I always have a plan and go with that but you are making a lot of sense. Thank you for your time today.\\nsupporter: Your welcome ;)\\nseeker: Have a great day and I might be back soon to give an update.\",\"kind\":\"MS\",\"reported_at\":\"2024-09-01\",\"schema\":\"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2\",\"speaker_scope\":\"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography.\"}","head":"MS","reported_at":"2024-09-01"}]
